lines.en: Let me tell you something. As a woman, there is nothing sexier than a man who does not want to have sex.
Oh, yeah. In fact, you know what I'd do?
Yes, absolutely. I would wait and wait.
Oh, yeah. I don't care how much she tells you she wants it.
I don't care if she begs, she pleads, she tells you she's going to have sex with another man.
